CA.rationale: Content entry for a candidate red cell is explicitly paired with an origin/process tag (command_estimate) in the same record.

COD.rationale: A current red content entry is presented with an explicit organizational pattern (coordinate sets) and a separate origin/status field.

A.rationale: Origin/process metadata (command_estimate/feedback_through) is explicitly attached to the same candidate content entry.

C.rationale: The report enumerates specific content entries (red/blue) with explicit coordinate sets.

D.rationale: Content entries are accompanied by separate origin/status fields (copied_prior_record, history_estimate), distinguishing identity from provenance/status.

O.rationale: The text specifies how contents are presented (coordinate sets, grid orientation) describing their organized spatial pattern.
